fact_text: Before privatisation the airline was split in two: legacy losses, trade debts and bulk borrowings moved to a holding company, leaving the operating airline with aircraft, routes and staff but little debt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The holding company took over about PKR 650 billion of PIA debt, together with trade debts and bad loans, under the restructuring scheme.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The holding company was listed on the stock exchange in May 2024 after PIA was delisted, with a one-for-one share exchange for existing PIA holders.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst framed the deal as taxpayers keeping the legacy debt while private buyers take the operating assets, which made a loss-making airline an attractive purchase.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A caretaker government in 2023 chose to privatise PIA, which the analyst linked to continued IMF emphasis on divestment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2023 a senior bureaucrat was brought in and tasked with readying PIA for privatisation, which the analyst presented as the start of the restructuring push.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's total liabilities reached about PKR 830 billion by 2024, before the restructuring moved most of the debt out of the airline.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Interest on PIA's borrowings alone exceeded PKR 100 billion in 2023, which the analyst said was a drag large enough to hurt the whole economy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Four bidder groups were shortlisted for the sale: a Lucky Cement, Hub Power, Cohat and Metro Ventures group, an Arif Habib-led group, Fauji Fertilizer, and Air Blue.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expected final bids for the PIA sale by December 2025, with due diligence, site visits and data-room access under way at the time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's load factor, the share of seats filled, was about 81% in 2019, a level the analyst called decent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's load factor fell to about 67% in 2021, after travel restrictions lifted and rival airlines resumed normal operations.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's load factor recovered to about 80% in 2022, although the EU and UK bans were already cutting its most profitable routes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's load factor reached about 83% in 2023, the highest level in the six years the analyst reviewed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2019 PIA's revenue per seat-km (RASK) was about 5.78 cents against a cost per seat-km (CASK) of about 6 cents, so each kilometre flown lost money.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2020 PIA's RASK was about 7 cents against CASK of about 6.8 cents, a small positive spread that the analyst called temporary relief rather than a turnaround.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2021 PIA's CASK jumped to about 8.23 cents against RASK of about 7 cents, a loss of roughly 1.2 cents per seat-km.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2022 PIA's RASK was about 7.4 cents against CASK of about 7.9 cents, a spread of minus 0.5 cents as lost EU and UK routes cut earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2023 PIA's RASK was about 6.9 cents and CASK about 6.8 cents, close to break-even after costs were pushed down during the privatisation preparation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After the 2024 restructuring, interest expense fell and PIA's spread turned positive at about 0.3 cents per seat-km, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Top global airlines typically run load factors of about 82% to 85%, meaning most seats are filled on average.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The global airline industry typically earns a spread of about 2 to 3 US cents between revenue and operating cost per seat-km.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Emirates, Qatar Airways and Turkish Airlines were cited as efficiency benchmarks, built on modern fleets, smart route planning and tight cost control.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Airline profitability is judged by RASK (revenue per available seat-km) minus CASK (operating cost per available seat-km); a positive spread means each kilometre flown earns more than it costs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst said high CASK comes from overstaffing, old fleets, low flying hours per aircraft and government involvement in operations, which together push unit costs up.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Between 2020 and 2024 EU and UK bans removed PIA's routes to London, Manchester and Birmingham, which the analyst put at about 30% of its profitable routes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The EU and UK bans cost PIA roughly PKR 40 billion of revenue a year, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Brent fell to about $42 a barrel in 2020, cutting airline fuel bills; the analyst said that relief was temporary and did not signal a turnaround.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Pakistani rupee held near 158 per US dollar in 2020, which kept dollar-linked airline costs under control.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2020 PIA ran mainly selective repatriation and charter flights, which the analyst said carried high margins during the pandemic.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When travel restrictions lifted in 2021 and rival airlines resumed normal operations, PIA's economics worsened because its costs rose faster than its seats were filled.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst saw reopening the EU and UK routes as the biggest upside lever, since they were among PIA's most profitable flights and would lift revenue and load factor.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Direct flights avoid transit and handling charges, and the analyst said customers would pay about 10% to 15% more for a non-stop route.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan normally lets businesses carry tax losses forward for three years; Finance Act 2024 allowed PIA ten years, so future profits can be offset by old losses.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A sales-tax exemption on aircraft purchases was described as cutting the acquisition price by about 18%, removing the roadblock that stalled an earlier privatisation attempt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argued that privatisation alone would not guarantee profits; results depend on load factor, the RASK minus CASK spread and staffing after the sale.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2023 the airline's share traded around PKR 3 before privatisation talk lifted it, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: By 2025 the same share had risen to about PKR 23, which the analyst attributed to investors pricing in the privatisation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's 2021 total revenue was about PKR 86 billion against operating costs of about PKR 101 billion, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PIA's operating margin was about 4% to 5% in 2024, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know about Investing in PIA's Turnaround Story' (YouTube transcript, undated)
